# Drinks By Neat

> Beverage consultancy and Neat AI systems for hotels, restaurants, bars, and drinks brands. Andreas Sanidiotis, based in New York.

Drinks By Neat is the practice of Andreas Sanidiotis: two desks, one operator. Beverage programs cover opening menus, refreshes, prep-lab design, white-label and RTD development, brand advocacy, and advisory retainers. Neat AI covers guest communication, booking and inquiry, a staff knowledge copilot, hotel upsell, loyalty and feedback, and analytics. Work is fixed-scope, costed before it starts, and handed over so the house owns it.

Andreas is based in New York (NY, US) and works in English and Greek. Programs have been delivered in New York, Austin, Nicosia, and Abu Dhabi. The practice serves New York City, the United States, the United Arab Emirates, and Europe. Work outside NYC is typically intensive on-site blocks with remote development between them.

Public record: World's 50 Best Bars #25 (Lost & Found Drinkery, Nicosia, 2018); nine consecutive years on World's 50 Best lists (2015–2023), the only Cypriot bar listed; Tales of the Cocktail Spirited Awards Top 10 nominee for Best International Cocktail Bar and Best International Bar Team (2018); Spirited Awards U.S. Regional Top 10 Honoree, Best New U.S. Cocktail Bar — In Plain Sight, Austin (2023).

Contact: sani@drinksbyneat.com. Book a 15-minute call at https://calendly.com/drinksbyneat/15.
